story.title: Arsenal move clear at the top with a rare win at Liverpool
story.summary: Arsenal win at Anfield for the first time since 2012 to earn a three-point lead at the top of the Premier League table following an end-to-end match that leaves Liverpool frustrated to have taken nothing.
